lesson.title: Choosing Where to Meet and Eat
lesson.subtitle: Topic-based beginner conversation lesson
lesson.description: Practice suggest where to go. Transcript-referenced conversational Mandarin study organized by communicative goal rather than audio track.

learning_objectives: Accept or reject a proposed location.

blocks.text: Topic lesson based on Conversational Mandarin, tracks 1–16. Dialogue is an editorial teaching exchange using source-attested expressions; it is not presented as a verbatim audio transcript.

turns.speaker: A
turns.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng qù nǎr chī wǔfàn?
turns.english: Where would you like to have lunch?

turns.speaker: B
turns.english: I would like to go to a restaurant.

turns.speaker: A
turns.english: How about going to the Beijing Hotel?

blocks.function_en: Combine destination and purpose in one sentence.

example.english: I want to go to a restaurant to eat.
example.teaching_note: Use this construction in your own dialogue.

blocks.function_en: Use 在 (zài) before a place to say where an action happens.

example.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng zài zhèr hē chá.
example.english: I want to drink tea here.
example.teaching_note: Use this construction in your own dialogue.

items.meaning_en: Where do you want to go?
Where do you want to eat?
I want to go to the hotel.
I want to go to the Beijing Hotel.
I want to go to your place.

items.pinyin: wǒ bù xiǎng zài zhèr chī
items.meaning_en: I do not want to eat here.
Where would you like to go for a drink?
Do you want to go to the hotel?

blocks.text: Speaking task: Invite a friend to a café, restaurant or hotel; decline one place and suggest another.

questions.prompt: In the model conversation, what does speaker B say in the first reply?
questions.answer: 我想去饭店。 (Wǒ xiǎng qù fàndiàn.) — I would like to go to a restaurant.
questions.explanation: Read the first two turns again, then answer without looking.

questions.prompt: Translate into Mandarin: Go to a restaurant.
questions.explanation: One model answer; another natural equivalent may be acceptable.

questions.prompt: Make a sentence using the pattern 在 + 地点 + 动词 (zài dìdiǎn dòngcí).
questions.answer: 我想在这儿喝茶。 (wǒ xiǎng zài zhèr hē chá.) — I want to drink tea here.
questions.explanation: Use the word order shown in the second grammar explanation.

questions.prompt: Invite a friend to a café, restaurant or hotel; decline one place and suggest another.
questions.answer: 你想去哪儿吃午饭？ (Nǐ xiǎng qù nǎr chī wǔfàn?) — 我想去饭店。 (Wǒ xiǎng qù fàndiàn.)
questions.explanation: Sample opening exchange. Continue the role-play in your own words.
